annotations.title: utilpeek: count business days or add working days (with public holidays)

description: utilpeek: Count business days between two dates or add working days, skipping public holidays. For the holiday list use get_public_holidays. Returns the business days between two dates (mode count; both ends included by default, like NETWORKDAYS) or the date N business days after or before a date (mode add, like WORKDAY), skipping weekends (configurable) and, with a country, its public holidays; plus the holidays skipped. Input: `mode`, `start`, for count `end` and optional `include_start` / `include_end`, for add `days`, optional `weekend`, `country` and `subdivision`. Ranges up to 20 years; with a country, dates in 1990-2100. Bad input is a 422 (not charged). Holiday rules are modelled by a library: confirm with an official source for legal or payroll use. Typically under 0.2 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/business-days-api.html

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country whose public holidays are not business days (the /v1/holidays data; dates in 1990-2100).
country.title: Country

days.description: add only: business days to add (negative subtracts). The start date is never counted (like Excel WORKDAY); 0 returns start.
days.title: Days

end.description: count only: end date, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 20 years from start (before start gives a negative count).
end.title: End

include_end.description: count only: count the end date (default true; both true is Excel NETWORKDAYS, include_end false the half-open [start, end) of numpy.busday_count).
include_end.title: Include End

include_start.description: count only: count the start date (default true).
include_start.title: Include Start

mode.description: count: business days between start and end; add: the date `days` business days after (or before) start.
mode.title: Mode

subdivision.description: Optional subdivision code or name for that country (e.g. CA or California for US).
subdivision.title: Subdivision

weekend.description: Weekday names that are not business days (default ["sat", "sun"]; e.g. ["fri", "sat"]; [] for none).
weekend.title: Weekend

name: count_or_add_business_days

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
